integrity: The stability region follows from an exact expected-squared-norm polynomial identity and discriminant sign proof; finite rational and matrix checks provide reproducibility only. Self-review passed; independent audit and historical-priority confirmation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact result concerns only a planar harmonic oscillator, a named two-stage fourth-order two-derivative Runge–Kutta formula, and one equiprobable multiplicative second-derivative perturbation reused at both evaluations within each step and independently resampled between steps. No results for hardware roundoff, independent stage errors, nonlinear or higher-dimensional dynamics, almost-sure stability, or finite-time convergence orders are claimed.
title: A sharp mean-square stability island for fourth-order two-derivative Runge–Kutta under symmetric curvature perturbations
